description: Get one radio station from OndaCast by slug or OndaCast page address: description, location, genres, language, frequency, the song playing now and the show on air when known, and the OndaCast page for listening. Stations that cannot play in a browser are not available. It is for listening to or playing a station: the answer links to the station's OndaCast page.

station.description: A station slug, or an address such as https://ondacast.com/station/{slug}.

name: get_station
title: Get a radio station
